name: Villa del Campo (Spain)
description: Green field with two white horizontal stripes and a white triangle at the hoist bearing the crowned municipal arms of Villa del Campo (a cross of Alcántara and an ear of wheat on white and green).
history: Municipal flag of Villa del Campo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
